description: This file defines a class for configuring account journals in an Odoo module, including methods for retrieving journal information, handling user interactions, and managing default account settings.

classes.name: Journal
classes.description: A class for managing journal configuration in an Odoo module, including methods for retrieving journal data, handling user actions, and default value management.

methods.name: _get_journal
methods.description: Retrieves the current journal based on internal step index.

methods.name: _get_debit
methods.description: Retrieves the default debit account ID for the current journal.

methods.name: _get_credit
methods.description: Retrieves the default credit account ID for the current journal.

methods.name: on_change_debit
methods.description: Updates the default debit account for a journal when changed.

methods.name: on_change_credit
methods.description: Updates the default credit account for a journal when changed.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Handles the cancel action, returning a form view for configuration wizard.

methods.name: action_new
methods.description: Advances to the next journal configuration or marks completion.
